messages:
Samira: Quick sync — we need to lock a post-incident for the latency spike that paged last night (INC-2348). Impact: failed requests for ~12m affecting Acme and BlueWave. Need a facilitator who wasn't on primary oncall. Who can host?

Lee: I can host — happy to facilitate on Thu morning PT. Not on primary last night.

Ankit: Thanks. Two candidate slots (incl. UTC conversions):
```
- Thu 2026-03-26 10:00 PT / 17:00 UTC
- Fri 2026-03-27 08:00 PT / 15:00 UTC
```
Which works for folks? Please call out conflicts.

DevOps Bot: Incident INC-2348 summary uploaded: https://redwood-internal/incs/INC-2348
Artifacts: logs, heap dumps, traces. Auto-created postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-2348

Ash: Thu slot works for me. Can we make it 60m and include infra + product?

oncall-bot: Paging timeline attached — 2026-03-24T02:14Z - 02:26Z. Notifying: @Samira @Lee @Ankit @Ash

Lee: I'll take facilitator. I didn't touch the primary mitigation so I'm good. I'll send the calendar invite + draft agenda.

Samira: Thanks Lee. Proposed agenda: impact timeline, root-cause hypotheses, mitigation chronology, action items + owners, customer comms draft. Add pre-reads to the doc if you have them.

Ankit: Attendees to add: Eng-infra lead (Priya), ML infra (Ben), Product PM (Nora), SRE oncall (Kai). Can someone ping Priya/Nora?

Ash: Pinged Priya and Nora — both confirmed.

Lee: Calendar invite created for Thu 2026-03-26 10:00 PT — 60m. Link: https://meet.redwood/abc123 (agenda + doc attached).

Samira: Confirmed. Lee, can you also capture action items in the doc during the meeting? I'll handle customer comms follow-up.

Lee: Yep — will own action-item capture. Adding a quick checklist to the postmortem doc:
```
- collect logs + traces
- confirm mitigations applied
- assign remediation owners
- estimate timelines
```

Ankit: I'll prep traffic graphs and sample failing requests. Ash — can you surface rollback/build details?

Ash: Yup, I'll bring the rollback timeline and CI artifacts.

Samira: Final ask — if you can't make it, react with :x: and nominate a delegate. Please RSVP in thread with :raising_hand: or :x: by EOD today.

Priya: :raising_hand: attending, will bring infra notes and K8s pod diffs.

Nora: :raising_hand: attending. I'll bring customer-impact notes and support transcripts.

Kai: :x: in that slot, will nominate backfill — @Ben are you available?

Ben: :raising_hand: can cover for Kai and will bring ML infra traces.

Lee: Great — looks like we're set. I'll capture minutes + action items and post them after the meeting. Thanks all :calendar:

DevOps Bot: Reminder scheduled 1h before meeting.
